summaryZh: Tai-Seale 团队研究医疗服务提供的科学，旨在改善健康结局、患者与医疗人员体验、医疗可负担性及医生职业状态。团队结合以用户为中心的设计、假设驱动和数据驱动研究，检验创新、理论与模型的影响。
researchQuestions: 医疗创新对健康结局、患者与医务人员体验，以及医疗可负担性有何影响？

evidence.quote: We are a multidisciplinary team of researchers, focused on the science of healthcare delivery. Combining user-centered design methods, hypothesis-driven and data-driven research methods, we rigorously test theories, models, and methods to determine the impact of innovations on health outcomes, human (patient and healthcare professionals) experience , and affordability of healthcare.
